IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY MARCUS GAETANI OWNER OF GAETANI REAL ESTATE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-02-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RIES, ROBERT J IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GAETANI REAL ESTATE,INC. DEFENDANT HAD NO DUTY TO SAFEGUARD PLAINTIFF'S PERSONAL PROPERTY & PLAINTIFF DID NOT ESTABLISH THAT THEFT WAS RESULT OF DEFENDANT'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE. IN ADDITION, PLAINTIFF WAS OBLIGATED TO MAINTAIN RENTER'S INSURANCE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED OCT-01-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
